args.prompt: Edit this original mobile game environment into a completely newly painted 2.5D semi-realistic semi-cartoon absurd contemporary Chinese neighborhood courtyard, polished production background. Match the original tall portrait aspect ratio and camera: elevated three-quarter view, distant skyline across top 16%, an uninterrupted wide playable rectangular ground plane from y=480 through y=1190 (roughly middle 45% of frame), scenery only at edges and upper band. Replace ALL original fantasy village art, original tree shapes, rocks, bridge, pavilion, grass texture and stone path with original new assets in a coherent absurd street-block style. Warm afternoon neighborhood community basketball-and-gardening courtyard, wide pale worn concrete and muted peach terracotta pavers with gentle perspective scale. On upper left an oversized cabbage-shaped community greenhouse integrated with real glass and brick; upper right a tiny brick laundry kiosk with friendly rounded washing-machine details; background apartment balconies and whimsical rooftop water tanks, warm moss-green/cream/orange palette. Edge planters shaped like dented enamel bowls and small manicured trees. A compact low footbridge over a tiny drain in the far background, repainted as neighborhood infrastructure, not a fantasy bridge. A few tiny cloth banners only at top, no text or pseudo-letters. Lower edge has low out-of-focus leaves and a curved bench, keep bottom center reasonably clear for game UI overlay. Lighting and materials tactile with subtle ambient occlusion and soft shadows, crisp readable forms, slightly exaggerated rounded proportions, restrained texture detail. Ground is quiet, no high-contrast marks or clutter across the playable center. Environment ONLY: no people, bulls, characters, enemies, vehicles, balls, fighting, effects, interface, buttons, logos, watermarks, titles, letters or numbers. Full image reaches all four edges, opaque background. Composition geometry should align with the reference so existing game characters and UI can be drawn over it.

notes: Inspected complete output: cabbage greenhouse, laundry kiosk and open courtyard; no actors/text/interface. Runtime geometry pending.
